Module com.identisure.client
Package com.identisure.client

Class IdentisureClient

java.lang.Object
com.identisure.client.IdentisureClient
public final class IdentisureClient extends Object
Authenticated HTTP client for the Identisure REST API.

Obtain an instance via IdentisureClientBuilder. All network calls return CompletableFuture and are non-blocking.
